name: Charles J. Giannetta

residences.note: Son, 24, trackman for a steam railroad; wife Jeanette 21 (in Scranton in 1935); daughter Angela, 1

bioAdditions: In April 1940 Charles J., 24, a steam-railroad trackman, lived in his widowed mother's house at 133 Sand Street with his wife Jeanette and their baby daughter (S1). He is probably the unnamed 4-year-old son in the January 1920 census (S2).

sources.citation: 1940 US census, Dunmore borough Ward 5, ED 35-66, sheet 4A (5 Apr 1940), 133 Sand Street: Angelica Genett (head, 64, widowed, b. Italy, owned house worth $1,000), sons Anthony (31) and Charles J. (24, trackman, steam railroad), daughter-in-law Jeanette (21), granddaughter Angela (1). Image attached to FamilySearch tree GQPJ-C82 (index ark 1:1:KQDW-7K6).
sources.supports: Angelica widowed by 1940; household at 133 Sand St
